speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please sit down. I see you are experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to begin my assessment, have you noticed if your tremors occur at rest or only when you are using your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you; since the tremor is unilateral and progressive with associated memory decline, have you noticed any stiffness or slowness in movement, particularly in your face or arms? Additionally, has your handwriting become progressively smaller and more cramped over the last year?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.
